arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
romanization: Rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'adhaaban-naar
english: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
romanization: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da idh hadaytanaa wa hab lanaa min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhaab
english: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
romanization: Rabbanaa dhalamnaa anfusanaa wa in lam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen
english: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
romanization: Rabbighfir lee wa liwaalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaat
english: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house as a believer, and the believing men and believing women.

arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
romanization: Rabbi-j'alnee muqeemas-salaati wa min dhurriyyatee, rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aa
english: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
romanization: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas-saaliheen
english: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into Your righteous servants.

arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
romanization: Rabbish-rah lee sadree, wa yassir lee amree, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisaanee, yafqahoo qawlee
english: My Lord, expand for me my breast, and ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue, that they may understand my speech.

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
romanization: Rabbi innee massaniyadh-dhurru wa anta arhamur-raahimeen
english: My Lord, indeed adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
romanization: Laa ilaaha illaa anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen
english: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
romanization: Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa dhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yunin waj'alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa
english: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us leaders for the righteous.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَىٰ وَالتُّقَىٰ وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَىٰ
romanization: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-hudaa wat-tuqaa wal-'afaafa wal-ghinaa
english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
romanization: Allaahumma aslih lee deeniyal-ladhee huwa 'ismatu amree, wa aslih lee dunyaayal-latee feehaa ma'aashee, wa aslih lee aakhiratiyal-latee feehaa ma'aadee, waj'alil-hayaata ziyaadatan lee fee kulli khayr, waj'alil-mawta raahatan lee min kulli sharr
english: O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs. And set right for me my worldly life wherein is my livelihood. And set right for me my Hereafter to which is my return. And make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a relief for me from every evil.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
romanization: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wa a'oodhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wa a'oodhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a'oodhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijaal
english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي
romanization: Allaahum-maghfir lee khateeatee wa jahlee wa israafee fee amree wa maa anta a'lamu bihi minnee
english: O Allah, forgive me my sins, my ignorance, my extravagance in my affairs, and what You know better than I.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
romanization: Allaahumma innee as'aluka 'ilman naafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
english: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
romanization: Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa
english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
romanization: Allaahumma-nfa'nee bimaa 'allamtanee, wa 'allimnee maa yanfa'unee, wa zidnee 'ilmaa
english: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
romanization: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-jannah wa a'oodhu bika minan-naar
english: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek refuge in You from the Fire.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَىٰ ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
romanization: Allaahumma a'innee 'alaa dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibaadatik
english: O Allah, help me to remember You, to give thanks to You, and to worship You in the best way.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
romanization: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min 'ilmin laa yanfa', wa min qalbin laa yakhsha', wa min nafsin laa tashba', wa min da'watin laa yustajabu lahaa
english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that is not beneficial, from a heart that does not humble itself, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
romanization: Allaahumma-hdinee wa saddidnee
english: O Allah, guide me and make me steadfast.

arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَىٰ دِينِكَ
romanization: Yaa muqallibal quloob, thabbit qalbee 'alaa deenika
english: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ، مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ
romanization: Allaahumma innee as'aluka minal khayri kullihi 'aajilihi wa aajilihi, maa 'alimtu minhu wa maa lam a'lam. Wa a'oodhu bika minash-sharri kullihi 'aajilihi wa aajilihi, maa 'alimtu minhu wa maa lam a'lam
english: O Allah, I ask You for all good, immediate and deferred, that which I know and that which I do not know. And I seek refuge in You from all evil, immediate and deferred, that which I know and that which I do not know.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَىٰ وَالسَّدَادَ
romanization: Allaahumma innee as'alukal hudaa was-sadaad
english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance and steadfastness.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
romanization: Subhaanallaah, walhamdulillaah, wa laa ilaaha illallaah, wallaahu akbar
english: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.

arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
romanization: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
english: There is no might nor power except with Allah.

arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
romanization: Astaghfirullaahal-'adheemal-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huwal-hayyul-qayyoom wa atoobu ilayh
english: I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Magnificent, whom there is no god but He, the Living, the Self-Sustaining, and I repent to Him.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
romanization: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammadin kamaa sallayta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheema innaka hameedun majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammadin kamaa baarakta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheema innaka hameedun majeed
english: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
romanization: Bismillaahi tawakkaltu 'alallaah, laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah
english: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
romanization: Bismillaah, Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal khubuthi wal khabaa'ith
english: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil male and female jinn.
